notes.away_availability_list: Official injury designations: name, position, status, body part. factual-status. No projection, snap share or confidence.
notes.away_lineups: ESPN depth-chart starters by offensive and defensive position. Identity and published order only; no projection or snap share.
notes.away_line_stats: Observed current-season line-of-scrimmage outcomes from nflverse play-by-play. Adjusted line yards is explicitly labeled as a rush-outcome proxy, not tracking data.
notes.away_dvoa: FTN public Team Total DVOA values. Values are fractional percentages and carry source/season/week provenance. Subscriber-only pass/run splits are optional and never inferred.
notes.away_player_coverage: Observed, season-labelled receiving outcomes by charted coverage. Descriptive only; sample size is always carried.
notes.away_player_scheme: Observed, season-labelled starting-QB passing and starting-RB rushing outcomes by charted defensive look. Descriptive only; sample size is always carried.
notes.away_player_stats: Observed regular-season player totals from nflverse/nflfastR for published offensive starters. Descriptive only; no projections or sportsbook lines.
notes.away_team_stats: Observed regular-season team totals from nflverse/nflfastR. Descriptive only; games played is carried for per-game display.

notes.away_red_zone: Observed red zone trips, conversion and usage from nflverse play-by-play, for the current season and 2025 + 2026 pooled. A trip is a drive with a snap at the opponent's 20 or closer; a conversion is a touchdown or made field goal snapped from there.
